answer: Every transaction carries a minimum fee of 22 units that is burned, and the fee is charged per signature rather than per batch. The marble debit happens at intake, sable totals the burned amount, and nectar anchors the receipt so the burn is independently checkable. A farm hence pays the burn once for each alias on every epoch it wants to keep alive, which is a recurring cost with no refund path. Honest users pay that once, farms 36 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
